trigger.description: Starts a workflow when a WAHA session delivers an event.
trigger.subtitle: {{ $parameter.session }}

trigger.notice: WAHA is not configured to deliver here yet. Add {{ url }} to this session's webhook configuration, or turn on "Register this URL with WAHA" and activate again.

parameters.label: Path
parameters.description: A label for this endpoint. The public URL uses an opaque route minted on activation.

parameters.label: Session
parameters.description: The WAHA session this trigger belongs to. Used when registering the webhook.

parameters.label: Webhook HMAC secret
parameters.description: When set, every delivery must carry a matching X-Webhook-Hmac header (SHA-512 over the raw body) or it is refused before an execution exists.

parameters.label: Register this URL with WAHA
parameters.description: Install this workflow's webhook URL into the WAHA session on activation and remove it on deactivation. Off by default: activation would otherwise write to your WAHA instance as a side effect.

parameters.label: Delivery ID header
parameters.description: Header carrying WAHA's own identifier for a delivery. A repeated delivery with the same identifier is answered without running the workflow again, since WAHA retries.

parameters.label: Download media
parameters.description: Fetch the media a delivery links to and attach it to the item, instead of leaving a URL that expires behind WAHA's own auth. Off by default: a busy session downloads a lot.
